value.rationale: The exact two-barrier firebreak allocation problem is physically motivated by limited intervention budgets, and proves all intermediate gaps have genuinely nonempty optimal ranges, not just two endpoint prescriptions. A complete formula, ordered critical risks, and exact eight-patch examples quantify structural tradeoffs; not a generic substitution or finite table result.
